708.desc:
Clade 9 x Melt l Fig Bar Live Rosin l 1g
Lineage: GSC x Ghost OG x Emerald Triangle Kush
Fig Bar is a hybrid strain combining Girl Scout Cookies, Ghost OG, and Emerald Triangle Kush. It has a pungent, gassy aroma with a strong, impactful smoke.
Live Rosin is a solventless concentrate made using fresh frozen cannabis plant material. The frozen plant material is first put through an ice water extraction process which separates the trichome glands from the plant material. Those trichome glands are then dried using extremely cold temperatures to remove the moisture. Once dried, the collection of trichome glands are pressed through a 25 micron filter utilizing heat and pressure to melt the rest away from the trichome glands and plant material. The result is an un adulterated form of cannabis resin that is a direct representation of the cultivar used to make it.
All Rosin is resin but not all resin is rosin. Rosin gets its name due to how it’s made. A concentrate can only be called rosin if the concentrate was made using heat and pressure to separate the resin from plant material. This Live Rosin was crafted from fresh frozen flower expertly cultivated by Clade 9, this Live rosin vape delivers a pristine flavor and cannabinoid profile with uncompromising quality. Made by using only ice water, heat and pressure capturing the most unadulterated expression of the plant’s terpene rich profile for a clean flavorful hit every time

894.desc:
Lookah Snail is one of the best 510 thread batteries. It is smaller than most pen-style batteries and compatible with all types of 510 units. 

The Lookah Snail features a 350mAh battery capacity with a 510 thread connection. The snail doesn't have temperature control heat settings; instead, it uses three variable voltage settings for the facility regulation. This is a similar way many mods work. The snail is not draw-activated but has a preheat mode.

The Lookah Snail features easy single-button operation.
Five (5) clicks will turn the unit on or off.
Three (3) clicks will adjust between three different voltage settings 3.2V - 3.6V - 4.2V. 
The integrated 350mAh battery is protected from over-time running, short-circuit, over-wattage, or overcharging. 
Once the voltage is running low, the LED blinks ten times to remind the user to charge the battery. After showing the low-power alert three (3) times, the system will lock the device until it has been recharged. 

The Lookah Snail pen batteries are charged through the Micro-USB port with a USB adapter at 0.5A. While charging, the LED light remains red, and once it's fully charged, the LED light will change color to green.
From fully charged, the Snail has a battery life of about 30 to 40 uses, depending on the battery voltage setting, what type of 510 thread units are being used, and the time for each hit. 

Package Content:
1 Snail Device
1 USB Cable
1 User Manual

Charge up your game with Twist Slim 2.0. Enjoy longer battery life and quick charging with a classic Ooze Smart USB charger and type C charging port. With pulse wave technology and Safe Sesh Mode, it’s the perfect device. Get yours from the discount dispensary supplier today!
The Twist Slim 2.0 has a sturdier feel that has more weight in your hand, and immediately tells you it’s a quality device. This new model has a more streamlined silhouette. The collar that used to hold the threading at the top of the battery is now flush, making it look longer despite only being 1cm taller than the 1.0 version. The flex temp dial on the bottom has also been updated. We lowered the voltage slightly, with a new range from 2.0V to 4.0V. This hits more of a sweet spot with pods that are notorious for burnt heating elements. Each voltage level on the dial is now a notch that clicks into place, so you know exactly how hot the device is heating at any given moment. The Twist Slim Pen features pulse wave technology, or buzzing feedback that tells you when the battery powers on and off, and when the unit has made a connection with the device. Click the button 5x to turn on and off and click 2x to activate Prep Mode. We highly recommend running a cycle of Prep Mode every time you turn the Twist Slim on. It does wonders to clear stubborn clogs in the pod! This battery has Safe Sesh Mode enabled, which means that the device can only heat in 10-second increments. This prevents overheating, protects the heating element, and preserves those tasty terpenes. There are 2 methods of taking a puff; press the button and inhale, or simply inhale! The battery life of the Twist Slim 2.0 is amazing. We gave it automatic shut-off, so it turns itself off after 10 minutes of inactivity. You’ll be amazed at how long you’ll go between charges now! Charging up this device is quick and easy. We include the classic Ooze Smart USB charger that screws onto the battery like a pod and uses a wall adapter. We’ve also given the device a type C charging port right next to the battery. Use a type-c charger (sold separately) and the device can be used while it’s charging! There’s no need to let low battery power kill your vibe. Both charging methods rapidly recharge the Twist Slim Pen.

1351.desc: Edibles are created either by infusing cooking oil or butter with cannabis extract, or by mixing extract directly into other ingredients. Because edibles are digested and absorbed by your stomach and liver, the activation is often longer than other consumption methods, taking on average 45 minutes, and sometimes up to 2 hours. It is important to start low and slow when consuming edibles so you don't over do it. Take extra caution to ensure edibles are out of the reach of children.
